de:
Das Wasser war immer ruhig.
Zu ruhig.

Dann kam die Welle.

Keine zweite.

Weil es nichts mehr gibt,
das eine zweite erzeugen könnte.
en:
The water was always calm.
Too calm.

Then the wave came.

There won't be a second one.

Because nothing is left
that could create another.

de:
Hier habe ich früher gelebt.
Zwischen Lichtern und Stimmen.

Jetzt ist alles still.

Das Wasser steht nicht mehr.
Es steigt.
Und es wird nicht aufhören.
en:
I used to live here.
Between lights and voices.

Now everything is quiet.

The water isn't standing.
It's rising.
And it won't stop.

de:

en:
I just wanted to look down.

A sound.
A light.

Too late.

The ground was never the problem.
It was what moved.

de:

en:
The forest was never meant for water.

But it's here.
Between the trees.

I saw something.
A fin.

There are no fins here.

de:

Und ich bald auch.
en:
The sun has grown.
I measured it.

Today it no longer fits in the sky.

The shadow is disappearing.

And soon, so will I.

de:

en:
The ice is no longer solid.

There is no water beneath.

Only depth.

And something
that looks back.

de:

en:
You are not alone here.

You never were.

Something has always been fishing with you.

And now it has seen you.
